name: mac-it-guy-pro
description: Personal IT guy for non-technical macOS users — remembers your machine, guards every action, explains what it did, and leaves reusable tools behind

interface.shortDescription: A careful IT person for your Mac — checkups, safe cleanup, backups, and tools you keep
interface.longDescription: Turns the assistant into a professional, careful IT person for someone who is not a programmer. Checks your Mac's health, reclaims disk space without ever deleting outright, organises files with an undo trail, diagnoses problems from evidence before touching anything, sets up real backups with a restore drill, and fixes home networks by finding the failing layer before you spend money. Everything it learns lives in ~/ITGuy as plain text you can read and edit, and every belief carries a date by which it must be retested. A command guard inspects every shell command before it runs, and a locked, transactional writer is the only thing allowed to modify its memory. macOS only.
defaultPrompt: Use $mac-it-guy to look over this machine and set things up.
If this Mac died tonight, what would I lose?
